summary: Practise sanctions risk assessment, screening, trade finance controls and audit documentation. Explore the five-day enterprise training course.
lede: Sanctions compliance connects exposure assessment with controls for payments, trade finance and humanitarian activity. For compliance, financial crime, trade and NGO operations professionals, the training develops practical workflows for screening, alert decisions and escalation. Participants also review correspondent banking and trade files, document decisions, and prepare audit evidence and remediation actions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who make or review sanctions-related decisions across financial services, international programmes and cross-border business. It suits intermediate practitioners who need to connect screening activity with risk ownership, operational controls and evidence.
modules: UN Sanctions Exposure and Risk Context
prerequisites: Working familiarity with at least one relevant area, such as compliance, financial crime, payments, trade finance, NGO grants or legal review, is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Bring an understanding of your organization’s general approval and escalation processes; implementation decisions should receive institution-specific legal and governance review.
